fact_english: The butaan, a large monitor lizard of southern Luzon and nearby islands, eats mostly ripe fruit, which is unusual for a monitor lizard.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang butaan, malaking bayawak sa timog Luzon, prutas ang karaniwang kinakain!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Bayawak na vegetarian. Kahit ako, hindi ko kinaya.

after_text: Kanal, hari ng Sulu, Tsina: buo na ang clue.
